app.name: tito
app.tagline: A refined cut — from walk-in to walk-out
app.title: tito — Book your slot

home.heroSupport: A clean finish, sterilized tools, and a fixed slot — book online in minutes.
home.aboutDefault: At tito we mix sharp barbering with a nursing mindset: sterilization, cleanliness, and careful detail. Not just a good cut — you feel safe from the chair to the door.
home.servicesSupport: Cuts, beards, and finishing details that keep you looking sharp.
home.howSupport: From your phone to the chair — everything stays clear.
home.step1Desc: Browse services and prices, pick what suits you
home.step2Desc: Select the day and time that works for you
home.step3Desc: Pay online or at the shop and wait for confirmation
home.hoursSupport: Hours in local time — pick the day that works for you.
home.visitSupport: Need help with a booking? We’re on WhatsApp.
home.bookingClosed: Booking is currently closed — contact us on WhatsApp
home.shareSupport: Send the link or QR so friends can book in one tap.
